title: 第十九章黑白灵犬第二十章兄弟的选择

老年修士急眼了，猛地一咬牙，像是下定了某种决心。
“好！好！好！”他连说三个“好”字，眼中闪过一丝决绝，“既然你们不肯相信我，那我就用东西抵押！”他说着，猛地一挥手，从腰间解下一个黑色的小布袋。这布袋约莫巴掌大小，材质奇特，隐隐透着灵光，竞然是一个养兽袋。老年修士将养兽袋捧在手中，深吸一口气，道：“这里面，是我饲养的两只变异灵犬，是我的心肝宝贝！我愿意用它们抵押酒钱！”
掌柜的眼中闪过一丝兴趣，道：“哦？变异灵犬？”他示意柜台管理员接过养兽袋。柜台管理员犹豫了一下，还是上前一步，将养兽袋接了过来，递给了掌柜。掌柜的神识探入养兽袋中，片刻后，眉头微微皱了起来。他将养兽袋丢回给老年修士，淡淡地说道：“这两只确实是变异灵犬，血脉还算不错，勉强值五十块下品灵石。不过，与你一千多块下品灵石的消费相比，还差得远呢。”
“五十块下品灵石？”老年修士像是被踩了尾巴的猫一样，猛地跳了起来，满脸的不可思议和愤怒，“你胡说！我这两只灵犬，可是我耗费了无数心血才培养出来的，别说五十块下品灵石，就算是一万块下品灵石，他也值！”他说着，眼神中充满了肉痛和不舍，“我只是暂时押在你们这里，等我凑够了灵石，一定回来赎！”
掌柜的冷笑一声，语气变得更加冰冷：“押在这里？谁知道你会不会一去不回？我们登云酒楼可没那么多时间给你养狗。你要是想赖账，可得考虑清楚后果！”
他的话语中，带着一丝毫不掩饰的威胁。老年修士浑身一颤，酒意醒了半分。他这才意识到，自己今天是真的闯祸了。登云酒楼能在临海城屹立不倒，背后的东家可是梦源商会。何况他只是一个小小的炼气修士，与登云酒楼背后的势力交恶，那是自取灭亡。
今天要是不把账结了，他恐怕真的很难走出这个门。可是，他全部的身家，就只有这两只变异灵犬了。老年修士的目光在大厅中扫过，看着周围那些或冷漠、或看戏的眼神，心中充满了绝望。就在这时，他像是突然想到了什么，眼睛猛地一亮。
他深吸一口气，从养兽袋中放出一黑一白两只灵犬，对着周围的人群大声喊道：“哪位有心的前辈愿意出手相助，以一千二百块下品灵石购买在下的爱犬？在下感激不尽，必将终身不忘这份恩情！”说完，他双手抱拳，对着四周深深鞠了一躬，态度极为诚恳。然而，周围的人群却一片寂静。一千二百块下品灵石，可不是一笔小数目。虽然那两只变异灵犬看起来确实不错，但也未必真的值这个价。而且，谁愿意为了一个素不相识的人，拿出这么多灵石？众人的目光，大多带着一丝看热闹的意味，没有人愿意发话。老年修士的身体，在众人的注视下，缓缓僵硬起来，脸上的血色也一点点褪去。就在他心灰意冷之际，一个略带笑意的声音，突然在人群中响起。
“好，这两只灵犬，我买了。”
众人循声望去，只见一个身着青色儒衫的年轻男子，从人群中走了出来。他面容俊朗，嘴角带着一丝淡淡的笑容，眼神中透着几分洒脱与从容。
正是秦枫。周围的人群顿时炸开了锅。
“什么？他真的要买？”
“一千二百块下品灵石啊！就为了两只变异灵犬？”
“这小子怕不是个傻子吧？”各种议论声、窃窃私语声此起彼伏。
苏管家也被秦枫的举动吓了一跳，他连忙快步上前，拉了拉秦枫的衣袖，低声道：“二公子，您三思啊！一千二百块下品灵石，可不是一笔小数目，而且这两只灵犬……”
秦枫拍了拍苏管家的手，笑着打断了他的话：“苏管家，放心吧，我心里有数。不就是一千二百块下品灵石吗？我就当是花钱买个善缘。”
他的声音不大，却清晰地传入了周围不少人的耳中。众人看向秦枫的眼神，顿时变得更加怪异了。老年修士却是大喜过望，他像是抓住了最后一根救命稻草一般，激动地看着秦枫，声音都有些颤抖：“前……前辈，您……您真的愿意买？”
秦枫笑了笑，没有说话，只是点了点头。
老年修士深吸一口气，双手紧紧地按在养兽袋上，指节因为用力而微微发白。一挥手将灵犬收入袋中，看着养兽袋，眼中充满了不舍与痛苦，显然是真的很在乎这两只灵犬。过了好一会儿，他像是终于下定了决心，猛地一咬牙，将养兽袋用力一抛，丢向了秦枫。

“前辈，这两只灵犬，就拜托您了！”老年修士的声音带着一丝哽咽，“我给他两取了名字，一个叫小黑，一个叫小白，希望前辈能善待它们。”
秦枫抬手，稳稳地接住了养兽袋。入手微微一沉，养兽袋中传来两声微弱的“呜呜”声，似乎是里面的灵犬感受到了主人的情绪，发出了不安的呜咽。
秦枫低头看了看手中的养兽袋，嘴角的笑容依旧，眼神中却闪过一丝不易察觉的光芒。
他能感觉到，养兽袋中那两只灵犬的气息虽然微弱，却十分纯净，而且隐隐透着一丝奇异的波动，似乎并非普通的变异灵犬那么简单。
“放心吧，我会善待它们的。”秦枫抬起头，对老年修士说道。
“多谢前辈！多谢前辈！”老年修士连声道谢，激动得热泪盈眶。
秦翊在一旁始终没有说话，他只是静静地看着这一切，目光在秦枫和那只养兽袋上扫过，若有所思。他知道，自己这个小弟虽然平日里看起来有些玩世不恭，但做事向来有分寸，既然他愿意花这么多灵石买下这两只灵犬，想必自有他的深意。苏管家见秦枫心意已决，也不再劝阻，只得无奈地摇了摇头，从储物袋中取出一千二百块下品灵石，递给了老年修士。老年修士接过灵石，到柜台前，将灵石交给了掌柜。掌柜的点了点灵石数量，确认无误后，脸上的神色这才缓和了一些，对着老年修士摆了摆手，道：“好了，账清了，你可以走了。”老年修士神态显得更老了，对着掌柜和柜台管理员匆匆行了一礼，又对着秦枫的方向深深鞠了一躬，这才头也不回地快步离去，很快便消失在了登云酒楼的门外。
一场闹剧，就此落幕。周围的人群见没有什么热闹可看了，也渐渐散去，只是偶尔还能听到几声关于秦枫“人傻钱多”的议论。秦枫将养兽袋小心翼翼地收起，这才转身看向秦翊，笑道：“大哥，我们也走吧。”
秦翊笑了笑，点了点头：“嗯，走吧。”
苏管家在一旁叹了口气，道：“二公子，那两只灵犬……真的值那么多灵石吗？”
秦枫神秘地笑了笑，道：“苏管家，这你就不懂了。有些东西，可不是用灵石能衡量的。”他说着，抬头看了看窗外已经完全暗下来的天色，眼中闪过一丝期待。
“小黑，小白吗？”秦枫在心中默默念道，“希望你们，不要让我失望。”秦枫的话若有所指。
四人不再停留，谈笑风生地走出了登云酒楼。门外，夜风微凉，街道两旁的灯火已经点亮，映照得临海城的夜色多了几分繁华与迷离。
秦翊、秦枫、姬行之和苏管家的身影，很快便消失在了街头的人流之中，只留下登云酒楼内依旧灯火通明，丝竹之声不绝于耳，仿佛刚才的一切，不过是这座销金窟中，无数故事里的一个小小插曲罢了。

The old monk became anxious and gritted his teeth suddenly, as if he had made some kind of determination.
"Okay! Okay! Okay!" He said the word "Okay" three times in a row, and a trace of determination flashed in his eyes. "Since you don't want to believe me, then I will use something as collateral!" He said, with a sudden wave of his hand, he took off a small black cloth bag from his waist. This cloth bag is about the size of a palm. It is made of strange material and has a faint aura. It is definitely a bag for raising animals. The old monk held the animal bag in his hands, took a deep breath, and said: "Inside are the two mutant dogs I raised. They are my darlings! I am willing to use them to mortgage the wine money!"
A glimmer of interest flashed in the shopkeeper's eyes, and he said, "Oh? A mutant spirit dog?" He motioned to the counter clerk to take the animal bag. The counter clerk hesitated for a moment, then took a step forward, took the animal bag, and handed it to the shopkeeper. The shopkeeper's consciousness penetrated into the animal bag, and after a moment, his brows furrowed slightly. He threw the animal bag back to the old monk and said calmly: "These two are indeed mutant spirit dogs with pretty good bloodlines. They are barely worth fifty yuan of low-grade spirit stones. However, they are far from what you spent on more than a thousand low-grade spirit stones."
"Fifty low-grade spiritual stones?" The old monk jumped up like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, with a look of disbelief and anger on his face, "You are talking nonsense! I have spent countless efforts to cultivate these two spiritual dogs. Not to mention fifty low-grade spiritual stones, even ten thousand low-grade spiritual stones are worth it!" He said, his eyes full of pain and reluctance, "I am only temporarily keeping you here. When I collect enough spiritual stones, I will come back to redeem them!"
The shopkeeper sneered and his tone became even colder: "Be here? Who knows if you will never come back? We at Dengyun Restaurant don't have that much time to raise a dog for you. If you want to default on your debt, you have to consider the consequences!"
There was an undisguised threat in his words. The old monk trembled all over, half awake from the drunkenness. Only then did he realize that he had really gotten into trouble today. Dengyun Restaurant can still stand in Linhai City because the owner behind it is the Mengyuan Chamber of Commerce. What's more, he is just a small Qi-refining monk, and turning against the forces behind Dengyun Restaurant would be his own destruction.
If he doesn't settle the bill today, it might be really difficult for him to walk out of this door. However, all he has is these two mutant dogs. The old monk's eyes swept across the hall, looking at the indifferent or theatrical eyes around him, and his heart was filled with despair. At this moment, he seemed to suddenly think of something, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
He took a deep breath, released two spirit dogs, one black and one white, from the animal bag, and shouted to the crowd around him: "Which caring senior is willing to help me and buy my dog ​​for 1,200 low-grade spirit stones? I am deeply grateful and will never forget this kindness for the rest of my life!" After saying this, he clasped his fists and bowed deeply to the surrounding people with a very sincere attitude. However, the crowd around them was silent. One thousand two hundred low-grade spiritual stones is not a small amount of money. Although the two mutated spirit dogs do look good, they may not really be worth the price. Moreover, who is willing to take out so many spiritual stones for a stranger? Most of the people's gazes seemed to be looking at the fun, and no one was willing to say anything. The old monk's body slowly stiffened under the gaze of everyone, and the color on his face faded little by little. Just when he was feeling discouraged, a slightly smiling voice suddenly sounded from the crowd.
"Okay, I bought these two spirit dogs."
Everyone looked around and saw a young man wearing a blue Confucian shirt walking out of the crowd. He has a handsome face, a faint smile on his lips, and a bit of freedom and calmness in his eyes.
It was Qin Feng. The surrounding crowd immediately exploded.
"What? He really wants to buy it?"
"One thousand two hundred low-grade spiritual stones! Just for two mutated spirit dogs? "
"Isn't this kid a fool? "All kinds of discussions and whispers came and went.
Butler Su was also startled by Qin Feng's actions. He quickly stepped forward, pulled Qin Feng's sleeves, and whispered: "Second Young Master, please think twice! One thousand two hundred low-grade spiritual stones is not a small amount of money, and these two spiritual dogs..."
Qin Feng patted Butler Su's hand and interrupted him with a smile: "Butler Su, don't worry, I know what's going on. Isn’t it just 1,200 low-grade spiritual stones? I just treat it as spending money to buy good luck. "
His voice was not loud, but it reached the ears of many people around him clearly. The look in everyone's eyes when they looked at Qin Feng suddenly became even weirder. The old monk was overjoyed. As if he had grasped the last straw, he looked at Qin Feng excitedly, his voice trembling: "Senior...senior, are you...are you really willing to buy it? "
Qin Feng smiled, said nothing, and just nodded.
The old monk took a deep breath and pressed his hands tightly on the animal bag, his knuckles turning slightly white from the exertion. With a wave of his hand, he put the spirit dogs into his bag and looked at the animal bag. His eyes were full of reluctance and pain. It was obvious that he really cared about these two spirit dogs. After a while, he seemed to have finally made up his mind. He gritted his teeth and threw the animal bag towards Qin Feng.
"Senior, I leave these two spiritual dogs to you! The old monk's voice was choked with sobs, "I gave them two names, one is Xiaohei and the other is Xiaobai. I hope the seniors can treat them well." "
Qin Feng raised his hand and caught the animal bag steadily. The hand sank slightly, and two weak "whining" sounds came from the animal bag. It seemed that the spirit dog inside felt the owner's emotions and let out an uneasy whimper.
Qin Feng lowered his head and looked at the animal bag in his hand. The smile on his lips was still there, but an imperceptible light flashed in his eyes.
He could feel that although the breath of the two spirit dogs in the animal bag was weak, it was very pure, and there was a hint of strange fluctuations. It seemed that they were not as simple as ordinary mutant spirit dogs.
"Don't worry, I will treat them well. "Qin Feng raised his head and said to the elderly monk.
"Thank you, senior! Thank you, senior! "The old monk thanked him profusely and was so excited that his eyes filled with tears.
Qin Yi remained silent at the side. He just watched all of this quietly, his eyes sweeping over Qin Feng and the animal bag, thoughtfully. He knew that although his little brother seemed a little cynical on weekdays, he always did things in a measured way. Since he was willing to spend so many spiritual stones to buy these two spiritual dogs, he must have his deep meaning. Seeing that Qin Feng had made up his mind, Butler Su no longer tried to dissuade him. He could only shake his head helplessly, took out one thousand two hundred low-grade spiritual stones from his storage bag, and handed them to the elderly monk. The old monk took the spirit stone, went to the counter, and handed the spirit stone to the shopkeeper. The shopkeeper clicked the number of spirit stones, and after confirming that it was correct, the expression on his face softened a little, and he waved his hand to the old monk and said: "Okay, the account is settled, you can go. "The old monk looked even older. He bowed hastily to the shopkeeper and counter manager, and then bowed deeply in the direction of Qin Feng. Then he left quickly without looking back, and soon disappeared outside the door of Dengyun Restaurant.
A farce ended here. Seeing that there was no excitement to be seen, the surrounding crowd gradually dispersed, but occasionally one could still hear a few comments about Qin Feng being a "foolish man with a lot of money". Qin Feng carefully put away the animal bag, then turned to look at Qin Yi and said with a smile: "Brother, let's go too. "
Qin Yi smiled and nodded: "Well, let's go. "
Butler Su sighed at the side and said: "Second Young Master, are those two spirit dogs... really worth so many spirit stones? "
Qin Feng smiled mysteriously and said: "Steward Su, thisYou just don’t understand. Some things cannot be measured with spiritual stones. "He said, looking up at the completely darkened sky outside the window, a trace of expectation flashed in his eyes.
"Xiao Hei, Xiao Bai? Qin Feng thought silently in his heart, "I hope you won't disappoint me." "Qin Feng's words have some meaning.
The four of them stopped staying and walked out of Dengyun Restaurant chatting and laughing happily. Outside the door, the night breeze was slightly cool, and the lights on both sides of the street had been lit, making the night in Linhai City a bit more prosperous and confusing.
The figures of Qin Yi, Qin Feng, Ji Xingzhi and Butler Su quickly disappeared among the crowds of people on the street, leaving only the Dengyun Restaurant still brightly lit and the sound of silk and bamboo playing endlessly, as if everything just now was just a small episode in the countless stories in this gold-selling cave.
